title: Taskflow Rate Limits
description: Caddy HTTP rate-limit activity (HTTP 429) for the Taskflow WAFs, derived from Caddy access logs in Loki. Counts show zero while WAF logs are arriving; breakdowns and recent requests are empty when no rejections occurred. Individual client IPs and URIs are parsed at query time and are not Loki labels.

panels.title: 429 responses — 5 min
panels.description: All HTTP 429 responses in Caddy access logs (last 5 minutes). Zero means no 429s while WAF logs are arriving; no data means no WAF logs in that window. The rejection-mix panel below separates rate-limiter 429s from other sources.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status" | __error__="" | status=429 [5m])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[5m])))

panels.title: 429 responses — 1 h
panels.description: All HTTP 429 responses in Caddy access logs (last hour). Zero means no 429s while WAF logs are arriving; no data means no WAF logs in that window. The rejection-mix panel below separates rate-limiter 429s from other sources.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status" | __error__="" | status=429 [1h])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[1h])))

panels.title: 429 responses — 24 h
panels.description: All HTTP 429 responses in Caddy access logs (last 24 hours). Zero means no 429s while WAF logs are arriving; no data means no WAF logs in that window. The rejection-mix panel below separates rate-limiter 429s from other sources.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status" | __error__="" | status=429 [24h])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[24h])))

panels.title: Rate-limited responses
panels.description: Caddy rate-limiter 429s per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes), split by application. Zones are frontend general and backend api/authentication. These carry rate_limit_zone; upstream/application 429s appear as Other 429 in the rejection mix.

targets.expr: sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Rejections by source
panels.description: Counts per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes). Coraza blocks come from transaction.is_interrupted, not HTTP 403. Rate-limiter rejections are 429s carrying rate_limit_zone; other 429s come from upstream/application code. Zone details are available in the recent-request rows.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" [$__interval])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone="" [$__interval])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Caddy request rate
panels.description: Average requests per second over the displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes), from access logs only, excluding /waf-healthz probes.

targets.expr: sum by (application) (rate({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Top paths receiving 429
panels.description: Request paths receiving HTTP 429, with query strings removed after JSON parsing. Aggregated at query time; paths are not Loki labels.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (request_path) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_uri="request.uri" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_uri!="" | label_format request_path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .request_uri "" }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top client IPs receiving 429
panels.description: Caddy's resolved visitor IP. Parsed at query time to avoid a high-cardinality Loki label; no per-IP Prometheus time series exist.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | status=429 | client_ip != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top hosts receiving 429
panels.description: Currently all public TaskFlow traffic uses www.jokelab.dev; the panel is kept for future hostnames on this Gateway.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (request_host) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_host="request.host" | __error__="" | status=429 | request_host != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent rate-limited requests
panels.description: Access-log summaries for Caddy rate-limiter rejections (rate_limit_zone set), including the resolved client IP and Retry-After response header. Upstream/application 429s are excluded. Open the Raw JSON evidence row below for the complete stored, redacted records.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", request_method="request.method", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone", retry_after=`resp_headers["Retry-After"][0]` | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!="" | line_format `{{.status}} {{.application}} | {{.request_method}} {{.request_uri}} | ip={{.client_ip}} zone={{.rate_limit_zone}} retry-after={{.retry_after | default "-"}}s`

panels.title: Identity drift — client_ip in pod CIDR
panels.description: Requests resolving into the pod CIDR (probes excluded). Legitimate in-cluster Gateway clients appear here occasionally; a sustained value that is not a known internal client means the trusted cilium_host peer changed, so per-client buckets are shared — re-run runbook Stage 0 and update trusted_proxies.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | client_ip=~`10\.42\..*` [5m])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[5m])))

panels.title: Pod-CIDR identity samples (client_ip in pod CIDR)
panels.description: Access-log summaries whose resolved client_ip is in the pod CIDR: known in-cluster clients, or the trusted-peer fallback after a node change. Open the Raw JSON evidence row below for the complete stored, redacted records.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json status="status", request_method="request.method", request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | client_ip=~`10\.42\..*` | line_format `{{.status}} {{.application}} | {{.request_method}} {{.request_uri}} | ip={{.client_ip}} zone={{.rate_limit_zone | default "-"}}`

panels.title: Raw rate-limited access records
panels.description: Latest 100 Caddy rate-limiter rejections as stored in Loki, after Caddy redaction. Includes the full stored request and response fields without line_format; upstream/application 429s are excluded.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" |= "\"status\":429" | json status="status", rate_limit_zone="rate_limit_zone" | __error__="" | status=429 | rate_limit_zone!=""

panels.title: Raw pod-CIDR identity records
panels.description: Latest 100 non-probe access records with client_ip in the pod CIDR, as stored in Loki after Caddy redaction. JSON parsing filters the records without rewriting their content.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"handled request\"" != "\"/waf-healthz\"" | json request_uri="request.uri", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | request_uri != "/waf-healthz" | client_ip=~`10\.42\..*`
